answer: The relic I would price into every new account is Certified flood warden appointment with flood authority attestation: an appointment the authority renews after exercise audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since an appointment the authority renews after exercise audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the sable is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The tide is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
